g.aria-label: Raw Product Likelihood: ∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ p(xᵢ | θ) → Floating-Point Underflow!
For n = 10⁹ examples: (1/2)¹⁰⁹ = 0.0 in float32 & float64
Product-rule gradient requires n products of n − 1 factors (no minibatching!)
Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL): ℓ(θ) = −∑ᵢ₌₁ⁿ log p(xᵢ | θ)
Additive gradient ∇ℓ(θ) = −∑ᵢ ∇log p(xᵢ|θ) enables unbiased minibatch SGD
